title: Bubba and Gump
about: Two pigeons James and Michael fed and named in the 4-H building, followed a few days later by an unexpectedly memorable pigeon funeral.
description: This track remembers Bubba and Gump, two pigeons that became temporary State Arts-In residents after James and Michael started feeding them in the 4-H building. What began with a few breadcrumbs quickly turned into names, personalities, and a running joke. A few days later, one of the pigeons died and the story somehow escalated into a funeral. It was brief, ridiculous, unexpectedly sincere, and exactly the kind of small event that became State Arts-In lore.
lyrics: James found a pigeon wandering the hall,
Michael said, "He's hungry," that started it all.
A couple little crumbs on the 4-H floor,
Then one became two coming back for more.
They weren't supposed to be hanging around,
But nobody had the heart to run them out.
Two little pigeons, plump as could be,
Living like they owned the whole facility.
And Michael named one Gump as well.
Like they paid to have it all.
But somehow you still ended up
But fate can turn so quickly,
A few short days went passing...
And one was on the ground.
Like they paid to have it all.
But somehow you still ended up
Was apparently the plan that day.
From getting fed by James and Mike
It only took a couple days
May there always be some breadcrumbs,
In that great 4-H building in the sky.
